brief.name: Lantern Drift
brief.pitch: Rotate paper tiles to link a thread of light across the board, then watch every lantern float up into the dusk.
mechanics: Tap a tile to rotate it and connect light paths
Link every lantern on the board with one continuous thread of light
Chain reactions release lanterns that float upward
A new daily board is available every day
brief.art_style: Warm paper-cut dusk with layered paper, soft grain, and no realistic humans
brief.tone: Calm, cozy, and a little clever
not_true: Does not offer real-money prizes or rewards
Does not use realistic humans in its art
brief.launch_goal: Drive installs from casual puzzle players through Meta, TikTok, and Google UAC during the global soft launch.

concepts.audience_note: Players who want a satisfying mental break in dead-time moments such as trains, flights, waiting rooms, and spotty-signal spots. They value a game that works anywhere and fits into short gaps.
concepts.angle: Show that the tap-only controls (just tap a tile to rotate it) are easy to play while standing, holding a strap, or on a bumpy ride.
concepts.hook_line: Just tap a tile. Even on a bumpy ride.

meta.headline: Just tap a tile. Even on a bumpy ride.
meta.text: One tap rotates a tile. Link the light, free the lanterns. Plays offline, no timers, about 3 minutes a level.

tiktok.text: Tap a tile to rotate it and link the light. Works offline, so it rides along anywhere.
